parent_model_scope: GRU source is a 72-scene DEV24+VAL48 development candidate, not an independent validation model; this force09 study adds no training.

metric_definitions.Q_m: RMS Euclidean position error over all 20001 state samples.
metric_definitions.task_SO3_rad: SO(3) geodesic RMSE against task attitude reconstructed by the frozen FULL72 metric scorer.
metric_definitions.inner_SO3_rad: SO(3) geodesic RMSE against filtered_attitude_reference over 20000 transitions.
metric_definitions.macro_mean: Arithmetic mean of the per-scene metric over completed rows in that group.

run_identity_binding: Candidate raw is scored only after run_start binds release, source/input manifests, parent model, scene payload, B raw, C5 lock, GRU model, and alpha=.9; B/C5 raw and status SHA values are bound by SCENE_INPUT_MANIFEST_v1.json.
